name: CI: Test and Measure (consolidated)
description: One caller workflow delegating lint (CSS/JS/PHP), JS tests, a PHP test matrix, build, the build-artifact gate, and optional a11y to the wp-ci.yml orchestrator in rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows. Jobs are gated on detected changes. Use this instead of the per-check ci/* callers; unlike them it supports a PHP x WP matrix.

inputs.description: Git ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to pin (tag, branch, or SHA).
Project shape the orchestrator presets on: plugin | theme | package.
Branch the push trigger watches (pull requests always trigger).
JSON array of PHP versions for the test-php matrix, crossed with wp_versions.
JSON array of WordPress core versions for the test-php matrix, crossed with php_versions.
JSON array of {php, wp} cells to drop from the matrix, e.g. [{"php": "8.4", "wp": "6.5"}].
Set to true to run the (slow) pa11y accessibility job on every run.
